statuses.verified_free: Documented free allowance, no payment and no expiry.
statuses.free_limited: Documented finite free allowance, rate/token limited.
statuses.local_free: Local software with no hosted billing.
statuses.paid: Officially paid; refused under free-only mode.
statuses.trial_only: One-off trial credit; not an ongoing free allowance.
statuses.unknown: Not established; refused under free-only mode.

providers.name: Google Gemini Developer API
providers.model_rule: The pricing page marks each model's Free Tier individually. Only models explicitly marked 'Free of charge' are eligible; gemini-4-argon and Pro preview models are documented as not available on the free tier.

providers.name: GroqCloud
providers.model_rule: Only models listed on the Free Plan tab are eligible. Fast inference is not unlimited inference.

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.model_rule: A model is eligible only when its id ends with ':free'. Never route an OpenRouter request to a paid variant.

providers.name: Ollama (local runtime)
providers.model_rule: Any locally installed model may be used, but capabilities stay unknown until /api/show or live discovery establishes them.

note: Documentation evidence only. A configured credential is still required for hosted providers, and no live provider request was made.
source: official documentation URLs recorded per provider
